manifest.author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
manifest.purpose: Per task: accuracy on fresh training-pool items (canonical and styled) vs matching dev sets, plus the model's most frequent answers on the training pool.
manifest.hypothesis: New tasks near zero on dev after 200 steps: H-plateau (not learned even in-distribution; output collapses to a few answers) vs H-gen (learned in-distribution but fails on dev tuples/families/contexts).
manifest.read_scope: model copies; freshly generated TRAINING-pool items (ctx.data, guarded); frozen dev sets; never sealed
manifest.measurement_definitions: accuracy = argmax equals gold; canonical = digits + full unit names; styled = p_word = p_abbr = 0.5
changelog: v2 (step 400): predicted and gold answer histograms on dev sets, after B's sense_newframe fell to 0.01 (below binary chance)
